parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe, typically made of cork or plastic, representing the Earth's surface with maps and markings.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface for geographical information and can be rotated to view different regions of the world.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its tilted axis supported by the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the supporting base and axis structure of the globe, usually made of metal to provide stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the sphere and allows it to rotate smoothly while keeping it elevated and balanced.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while allowing the sphere to rotate freely around its axis.
